budget_items.what_was_said: The town got a cost estimate to replace deteriorated steel force main pipe at the Dana Street pump station using the current maintenance contractor's subcontractor. The commission noted this was more expensive than a similar repair done at the Mass One pump station.

budget_items.what_was_said: Andrew Villery said Munis reverted to old (2022) rates during a bill run, producing a lower minimum bill rate than the correct current rate; the error affected any bill over the minimum and required supplemental billing to correct.

Andrew Villery estimated the current delinquency rate on sewer accounts, noting some bills are very high; a commissioner asked when unpaid balances get attached to a property, and was told delinquency of one year triggers that.

minutes.headline: Sewer Commission elected new officers and approved emergency Dana Street pump station repair work.
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Sewer Commission reorganized, electing Brett Ramston chair, Scott Dah vice chair, and Dan Proctor clerk, welcoming two new members. It approved moving forward with an emergency force main repair at the Dana Street pump station, reviewed a Munis billing error that required supplemental FY25 Q4 billing, and got an update on a manhole repair contract funded partly by ARPA/OPA money.

what_happened.line: Commission voted to proceed with an emergency force main repair at the Dana Street pump station.
Commission reorganized, electing Brett Ramston chair, Scott Dah vice chair, and Dan Proctor clerk.
A Munis billing error reverted sewer rates to an old schedule during a bill run, requiring supplemental Q4 billing to correct affected accounts.
A manhole repair contract was awarded to Insituform Technologies, funded partly by ARPA/OPA money with the remainder from the commission's budget.

why_it_matters: The Dana Street repair draws on a capital line item the commission says was set aside for this work, and staff were asked to check for a warranty without delaying the approved repair.
Sewer customers whose Q4 bill was set under the reverted rate schedule should expect a supplemental bill correcting it to the current rate.
The manhole repair contract, tied to a federal ARPA/OPA grant with town funds covering the balance, addresses infiltration and inflow into the sewer system.
watch_next: Next meeting, June 10, 2025: update on Dana Street repair and warranty inquiry, plus manhole repair contract progress.
